title: DevOps Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Title**
DevOps Engineer / Platform Engineer
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The DevOps Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, automating, and managing the organization's application delivery platforms and infrastructure components. The role focuses on CI/CD pipeline management, container orchestration platforms, infrastructure automation, platform reliability, security integration, and operational excellence. The individual will work closely with development, infrastructure, security, andcloudteams to ensure efficient, secure, and scalable application deployment and operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**CI/CD DevOps Management**

* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application build, test, and deployment processes.
* Manage and administer DevOps platforms, repositories, build agents, and runners.
* Automate application deployment, testing, and release processes.
* Implement DevSecOps practices within CI/CD workflows.
* Troubleshoot pipeline failures and deployment issues.
* Optimize build and deployment performance.

**Container Kubernetes Platform Administration**

* Deploy, manage, and maintain containerized application platforms.
* Administer Kubernetes environments including:

+ Rancher
+ Red Hat OpenShift (OCP)

* Configure namespaces, ingress controllers, storage classes, RBAC, and cluster security.
* Monitor cluster health, capacity, and performance.
* Manage container image repositories and lifecycle.

**Docker Administration**

* Build, secure, and manage Docker container environments.
* Define and maintain approved base images.
* Implement container security best practices.
* Support application teams in containerization initiatives.

**Linux Infrastructure Administration**

* Administer and maintain Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) environments.
* Perform system hardening, patching, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
* Manage operating system performance and availability.
* Maintain platform documentation and configuration standards.

**Middleware Platform Services**
**Administer And Support**

* HAProxy
* Nexus Repository Manager
* Keycloak Identity and Access Management
* Access Manager solutions
* HashiCorp Vault

**Responsibilities Include**

* Installation and configuration
* Security hardening
* High availability implementation
* Certificate management
* Backup and recovery
* Performance tuning

**Security Secrets Management**

* Implement secure authentication and authorization mechanisms.
* Manage secrets, certificates, tokens, and credentials using HashiCorp Vault.
* Integrate security controls within CI/CD pipelines.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security standards.
* Coordinate vulnerability remediation activities.

**Logging, Monitoring Observability**

* Implement and manage centralized logging platforms such as:

+ ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana)
+ Graylog

* Create dashboards, alerts, and monitoring solutions.
* Perform log analysis and troubleshooting.
* Support incident investigation and root cause analysis.

**CloudPlatform Support**

* Support deployment and operations oncloudplatforms:
* Configurecloud-native services supporting DevOps operations.
* Assist incloudinfrastructure automation and optimization.
* Support hybridcloudand container-based deployments.

**Automation Infrastructure as Code**

* Automate infrastructure provisioning and platform configuration.
* Develop scripts and reusable automation components.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using approved tools.
* Improve operational efficiency through automation.

**Platform Reliability Operations**

* Ensure high availability and resilience of platform services.
* Participate in incident management and problem management activities.
* Maintain disaster recovery and backup procedures.
* Create and maintain operational runbooks and SOPs.

**Experience**

* Up to 3 years ( 2 candidates) , 3-5 years ( 1 Candidate) of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering.
* Hands-on experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience administering Kubernetes platforms in enterprise environments.
* Experience supporting containerized applications and platform services.
* Experience with Linux system administration and middleware platforms.

**Technical Skills**
**Mandatory**

* CI/CD Pipeline Design Management
* Git-based Source Control Systems
* Build Runners and Agents Administration
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Rancher
* Red Hat OpenShift (OCP)
* HAProxy
* Nexus Repository Manager
* Keycloak
* Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
* Scripting (Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar)

**Preferred**

* HashiCorp Vault
* Access Manager Solutions
* ELK Stack
* Graylog
* Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, etc.)
* DevSecOps Toolchains

This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Integration Engineer
description:

 **Mirth** 
 and

 .
* Build and maintain APIs, interfaces, message flows, data transformations and system\-to\-system connections.
* Strong practical experience with:
* REST APIs
* SQL
* JSON
* Webhooks
* OAuth2 / OpenID Connect
* API security
* Data mapping and transformation
* Support identity and access integrations, including
 **Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, SSO, RBAC and service accounts** 
 .
* Troubleshoot integration issues, monitor data flows, investigate failures and support production services.
* Work directly with vendors and internal teams to understand requirements, test APIs and resolve integration issues.
* Create clear technical documentation for integrations, mappings, endpoints and support processes.

 **HL7 v2, ADT/ORU messages, FHIR, clinical workflows and patient identity data** 
 .
* Experience with AI\-related integrations would be useful, including connecting enterprise systems to Cally, Copilot or other AI\-enabled services.
* This is a practical delivery role — the focus is on
 **building, configuring, testing, troubleshooting and supporting integrations** 
 , not enterprise architecture or strategy.
* To adhere to the Information Security Management policies and procedures

title: Senior Software Test Engineer
description:
**Key Responsibilities** 
* **End\-to\-End Functional Testing:** 

 Analyze user stories to design and execute end\-to\-end test cases across unit, integration, system, regression, and acceptance levels.
* **API Testing \& Services:** 

 Automate and manually validate REST/GraphQL APIs, payloads, HTTP status codes, OAuth/JWT authentication, and schema contracts.
* **Test Automation \& CI/CD:** 

 Build, maintain, and execute scalable web/mobile automation frameworks, integrating test suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* **Performance Testing:** 

 Conduct load, stress, and endurance tests to identify system bottlenecks, server latency, and query inefficiencies.
* **Security Checks:** 

 Perform basic vulnerability scanning (OWASP Top 10\) including XSS, SQL injection, and authorization/IDOR bypasses.
* **Defect Management:** 

 Log, prioritize, and track bugs through resolution while collaborating with cross\-functional Agile teams.Lead and mentor junior and mid\-level QA/SDET team members.
* **Lead and mentor** 

 junior and mid\-level QA/SDET team members.
* **Own the QA strategy,** 

 testing approach, and quality standards for assigned projects.
* **Review test cases, automation scripts, and testing practices** 

 to ensure quality and consistency.
* **Provide technical guidance** 

 on automation, API, performance testing, and debugging.
* **Identify testing risks, blockers, and skill gaps,** 

 and proactively address them.
* **Collaborate closely with developers** 

 to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve defects, while providing clear technical feedback to improve overall code and product quality



  




**Key Skillsets** 

**Languages** 





 Python/Java/TypeScript / JavaScript
 




**Automation** 





 Playwright/Selenium/Cypress
 




**API Testing** 





 Postman, REST Assured, or Playwright API
 




**Performance** 





 JMeter/k6
 




**Security** 





 OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite
 




**CI/CD \& DevOps** 





 Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker, Git
 




**Databases \& Tools** 





 SQL, Jira, Xray / Zephyr
